events.summary: Lanxin (quote LXC-QT-26-0412, lapses 16 October, 21 days left) covers five bare PCBs (HR-30110, HR-30120, HR-30150, HR-30180, HR-30190), all FOB Taoyuan with Taiwan origin claimed, no duty on the price, and freight not in the data. Against what Halden paid last at the 1,000-piece break: HR-30110 15.76 vs 15.13 USD (+4.2%), HR-30120 9.57 vs 9.23 (+3.7%), HR-30150 3.16 vs 3.03 (+4.3%), HR-30180 16.48 vs 15.83 (+4.1%), HR-30190 45.52 vs 43.70 (+4.2%). Lead time is 42 days for the 6-, 8-layer boards (21 days for 4-layer), counted from the order; tooling 350 USD per part, waived on repeat orders of an unchanged revision. Lanxin's open orders are under a laminate allocation notice, with revised promises of 16 and 19 October, and none of the five parts has forecast demand on file, so what lapsing costs is still unknown and Marcus Chen must say which parts Halden will buy.

actions.subject: HPO-26-00629 line 10, PCB HR-30110: earlier date or partial shipment
actions.body:
Dear Huang Shu-fen,

Thank you for your 16 September lead time update. It moves HPO-26-00629/10, PCB, safety controller rev B (HR-30110), 830 EA, from the promised date of 25 September to 16 October. This is the consigned board for our safety controller build, so the later date carries straight through to our robot builds.

Could you please tell us whether any part of the 830 EA can ship earlier than 16 October, as a partial shipment, and whether the whole line can be brought forward? If so, please give the quantity and the date for each shipment.

Please confirm that you have acknowledged the order, the current production status, and the ship date and carrier for this line.

Please reply as soon as you can.
